prompt:
A full-body character image, vertical 2:3 (1024×1536): Lü Meng of the Romance of the Three Kingdoms, reimagined as an adult woman — the soldier who read books and in three days became another person.

1. STYLE
Korean MMORPG character artwork. A recognisably drawn face with gently simplified anatomical structure. 2D painting with visible brushwork: layered strokes of colour, soft broken edges, thin coloured linework and a few crisp accents on the face and costume.
Her face is small and soft: a short midface, a softly rounded jaw and a small chin, about 1.3 times as long as it is wide, with her eyes open at their natural size. Bangs, side locks and headpieces frame the face without lengthening it.
Skin finish: dewy, glass-like highlights on the skin of her shoulders, arms, collarbones and legs — a soft, luminous wet-look sheen that follows the body's forms; her face keeps a soft, natural finish.

2. CHARACTER
Age: late twenties — a graceful grown-up face with soft, smooth contours.
Face — her own, recognisably this character, a woman's face with no beard or facial hair: a sharp, striking, intense look; fair skin; delicate V-line face with a small, soft chin; large eyes — large round eyes, outer eye corners drooping downward; gracefully arched brows; upturned nose; soft, full lips; ember-orange eyes; smoky dark eye makeup.
Body and hair: petite and compact yet curvaceous — full bust and rounded hips on a small frame build; a pixie cut with asymmetric bangs; deep wine-red hair.
Expression: a faint knowing smile, subtle and relaxed.
Legend, carried in her design and bearing: a rough soldier turned brilliant strategist, books strapped beside her saber, the white-robed stealth assault on Jing.
Anatomy: one head, two arms and two legs, each joined at its natural joint; natural hands with five fingers.

3. COSTUME AND EQUIPMENT — MECHA
Costume: a female mecha personification built as an assault-type mecha frame — heavy armor plates, thruster packs, reinforced limbs, her weapon rebuilt as a large mecha armament. Solid hard-surface plates with visible joints cover her frame except at the openings named under Exposure; any cape or skirt is made of rigid armored plates; her face and hair stay human.
Silhouette: mecha armor shaped like a medieval knight's plate — big rounded pauldrons, a breastplate, layered plates below the waist, a head ornament instead of a helmet so her face shows. This silhouette sets the overall shape of the costume above — keep its materials, ornaments and rank in this shape; the details are free.
Colours: crimson red, gold, river teal, black lacquer. Faction frame: crimson and black lacquer plating with gold edges, streamlined naval hull shapes and fin binders, hydrojet thrusters, flame-orange glow lines.
Signature item: a saber with a book strapped to its scabbard, rebuilt as a far-future high-tech version of the same kind of object with the same silhouette — hard-surface alloy plates with panel lines, mechanical joints, vents and emitter nodes, an energy edge, plasma blade or glowing core in her glow-line colour and small status lights, with any animal motif re-sculpted as sleek machined armour. She holds it at full scale: one whole object, drawn once, held in front of or beside her body; a long weapon keeps one straight, unbroken shaft with a single head or blade.
Exposure (bold): her mecha frame is cut open by design in only these places — a deep open chest window with natural cleavage framed by the chest plates, and bare upper thighs between the hip armor and thigh-high leg plates; everywhere else she stays fully plated. The plates stay on, fitted and symmetrical, with skin clearly showing in each opening. Intimate areas covered; keep the plate material and palette.

4. SCENE
World: year 2190, the Wu carrier fleet in orbit above an ocean world: crimson starships and carriers, a glowing nebula, the planet's blue oceans and storm clouds below, neon running lights on the hulls.
Pose: standing confidently, her body turned slightly while her face looks toward the viewer.
Light: a soft key light with a strong rim light tracing her hair, shoulders and armour; bright, crisp specular highlights on metal and jewellery, and a clean, warm-neutral sheen on her skin.
Composition: her whole figure from the top of her head or headpiece to both feet inside the frame with clear margins, about four-fifths of the image height; camera at chest height with natural portrait perspective.

5. CONSTRAINTS
One figure only — no second character, horse or other creature. No readable text or numbers — emblems are abstract insignia shapes only, never letters or Chinese characters. No logo, watermark, speech bubble or frame border. A far-future setting only — space stations, starships and high-tech structures — with no traditional East-Asian architecture.
Avoid: a blue or bruise-like tint on the skin around the eyes, glossy or shiny highlights on the face, sweaty, oily or plastic-looking skin.

observations: 1024×1536 full body; single adult woman; wine-red hair and book-bearing saber.
Two arms and two legs; both hands present; no obvious extra limbs.
